papers.title: Study on the Microstructure and Properties of TC4 Alloy Based on Water-Jet-Guided Laser Technology
papers.abstract: Ti–6Al–4V (TC4) dual-phase titanium alloy is widely used in aerospace components owing to its excellent strength-to-weight ratio and high-temperature stability. However, conventional machining often generates a wide heat-affected zone (HAZ) and oxide or recast layers, which deteriorate the microstructure and reduce long-term reliability. In this study, the water-jet-guided laser (WJGL) process was applied to investigate how coupled laser–water interactions influence the groove morphology, elemental distribution, and crystallographic evolution of TC4 alloy. Under optimized parameters, the WJGL process reduced the HAZ width to less than 1 μm, effectively removed the resolidified layer, and suppressed surface oxidation. SEM, EDS, and EBSD analyses confirmed that the α + β dual-phase structure remained stable, with no significant phase transformation or grain coarsening. Compared with conventional laser cutting, WJGL achieved smoother surfaces, improved interfacial integrity, and reduced thermal damage. These findings highlight the potential of WJGL for precision machining of high-performance titanium alloys and provide theoretical and experimental support for enhancing the microstructural control and service reliability of aerospace TC4 components.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及TC4合金的水射流导引激光切割，而非增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的后处理，且未报告力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper studies a cutting process on wrought TC4, not a post-processing treatment for additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, and it reports no mechanical (fatigue/tensile) data.

summary_zh.motivation: 常规激光加工TC4产生热影响区和氧化层，需要改进加工质量。
summary_zh.method: 采用水射流导引激光(WJGL)工艺加工TC4合金，分析耦合激光-水作用对沟槽形貌、元素分布和晶相演化的影响。
summary_zh.result: 优化参数下WJGL将热影响区宽度降至1微米以下，消除重熔层，抑制表面氧化，保持α+β双相稳定。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EDS和EBSD表征验证微观结构改善。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional laser cutting of TC4 titanium alloy produces wide heat-affected zones and oxide layers, degrading surface integrity.
summary_en.method: Water-jet-guided laser (WJGL) processing was applied to TC4 alloy, and the coupled laser-water interactions on groove morphology, elemental distribution, and crystallographic evolution were analyzed.
summary_en.result: Under optimized parameters, WJGL reduced the HAZ width to below 1 μm, removed the resolidified layer, suppressed surface oxidation, and preserved the stable α+β dual-phase structure.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization using SEM, EDS, and EBSD confirmed the microstructural improvements.

papers.title: Rapid densification of cold-sprayed Ti–6Al–4V coatings via induction heating
papers.abstract: Cold spray is a promising solid-state additive manufacturing technique for depositing Ti-6Al-4V alloy. However, due to the alloy’s high strength, the resulting coatings are often porous. While vacuum furnace heat treatment can effectively reduce porosity, it is time-consuming, typically requiring several hours. In this study, a rapid post-processing method using induction heating was investigated. Cold-sprayed Ti-6Al-4V coated samples were subjected to induction heating at 900 ˚C, 1000 ˚C and 1100 ˚C for 10 minutes. The treatment significantly reduced the coating porosity from 3.1% to 1.2%. The treatment also improved interfacial bonding of the coatings and flexural strengths of the samples. The enhancements are attributed to the athermal effects of eddy current, which promotes preferential localized Joule heating and enhances atomic diffusion around the pores. This work demonstrates the potential use of induction heating as a fast and effective post-processing method on cold-sprayed Ti-6Al-4V coatings.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了感应加热后处理对冷喷涂Ti-6Al-4V涂层致密化和力学性能的影响，直接相关于后处理工艺对钛合金性能的调控。
llm.why_not_core: Does not include fatigue testing or detailed microstructural analysis beyond porosity; only flexural strength is reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发一种快速后处理方法以减少冷喷涂Ti-6Al-4V涂层的孔隙率。
summary_zh.method: 对冷喷涂Ti-6Al-4V涂层样品在900-1100°C进行10分钟感应加热。
summary_zh.result: 孔隙率从3.1%降至1.2%，界面结合和弯曲强度均得到改善。
summary_zh.validation: 通过弯曲力学测试和孔隙率分析验证效果。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a rapid post-processing method to densify cold-sprayed Ti-6Al-4V coatings which are typically porous due to the alloy's high strength.
summary_en.method: Induction heating was applied to cold-sprayed Ti-6Al-4V coated samples at 900, 1000, and 1100 °C for 10 minutes.
summary_en.result: Porosity was reduced from 3.1% to 1.2%, and interfacial bonding and flexural strength were significantly improved.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through flexural mechanical testing and porosity analysis using image processing.
